scripts.build:android: yarn create:android && yarn optimize:android && yarn finalize:android
scripts.finalize:android: node replace-in-files.js '#212121' '@color/fluent_default_icon_tint' ./dist --exclude="*.selector" --recursive && node replace-in-files.js '"http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"' '"http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" android:autoMirrored="true"' $(awk '$0="./dist/"$0".xml"' rtl.txt)
scripts.optimize:android: find ./dist/ -type f -name '*.svg' -delete && AVOCADO=$(yarn workspace @fluentui/system-icons-repo bin avocado) && find ./dist/ -type d ! -name '*_selector.xml' -exec sh -c 'exec "$AVOCADO" -q "$1"' _ {} \;
scripts.deploy:android: yarn build:android && rm -rf ../android/library/src/main/res/drawable && mkdir ../android/library/src/main/res/drawable && find ./dist/ -type f -name "*.xml" -maxdepth 1 -exec cp {} ../android/library/src/main/res/drawable \; && yarn clean
scripts.deploy:react: yarn build:react && rm -rf ../react/src/components && mkdir ../react/src/components && find ./dist/ -type f -name "*.tsx" -exec cp {} ../react/src/components \; && yarn clean
scripts.build:fonts: yarn generate:svg && find ./dist -type f -name '*.svg' -exec yarn run -T svgo --config svgo.config.mjs {} + && mkdir dist/fonts && yarn generate:font-regular && yarn generate:font-filled && yarn generate:font-light && yarn generate:font-resizable && node replace-in-files.js '\\' '0x' dist/fonts/*.json
scripts.deploy:fonts: yarn build:fonts && cp -a dist/fonts/* ../fonts && yarn clean
scripts.build:flutter: mkdir dist/flutter && yarn generate:flutter-icon-lib-class && yarn generate:flutter-icon-demo-class
scripts.deploy:flutter: yarn build:flutter && cp ../fonts/*.ttf ../flutter/lib/fonts && cp dist/flutter/fluent_icons.dart ../flutter/lib/src/fluent_icons.dart && cp dist/flutter/sample_icons.dart ../flutter/example/lib/sample_icons.dart && yarn clean
